# Apostra Python SDK

Read `SKILL.md` in this package before implementing an Apostra task.

- SDK guide: https://docs.apostra.com/v2/sdk
- V3 HTTP contract: https://docs.apostra.com/v3/http-api
- Authentication: https://docs.apostra.com/v3/authentication
- Complete documentation corpus: https://docs.apostra.com/llms-full.txt

The public documentation is the source of truth for operation inputs, results,
permissions, and behaviour.
